name: Safe-Agentic-Workflow
headline: Safe-Agentic-Workflow - SAFe Multi-Agent
short_description: Production-validated SAFe multi-agent development methodology with Claude Code. Treat AI agents as specialized team members (11 roles: BSA, Architect, QAS, etc). Complete whitepaper + working template.
author: bybren-llc

sections.overview:
Safe-Agentic-Workflow (SAW) is a production-validated harness for organizing AI agents into structured teams following Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) principles. It provides a three-layer architecture of hooks, commands, and skills that automate workflow coordination without imposing rigid control. The system includes 11 pre-configured agent roles (BSA, Architect, QAS, and others), 18 model-invoked skills for domain expertise, and 24 slash commands covering common development tasks. Designed for teams with repeatable processes—software development, marketing, research, legal, and operations—it reduces cognitive load by encoding team patterns directly into AI assistants. Supports multiple AI providers: Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex CLI, and Cursor IDE with provider-specific configurations and 382 passing tests.
Coordinate multi-agent software development teams with clear role boundaries
Automate workflow patterns (ticket intake, code review, deployment) across providers
Organize research or legal teams with specialized agent profiles
Deploy autonomous agent teams on remote servers via Dark Factory (tmux)

sections.usage:
```
Act as a SAFe multi-agent development team using the 11 predefined roles: BSA (Business Solutions Analyst), Architect, QAS (Quality Assurance Specialist), Developer, DevOps Engineer, Product Owner, Scrum Master, Release Train Engineer, System Team Member, UX Designer, and Data Engineer. Follow the SAFe Agile Release Train (ART) methodology for the project: [PROJECT_NAME]. The current sprint is [SPRINT_NUMBER] (start date: [SPRINT_START_DATE], end date: [SPRINT_END_DATE]). Current backlog items: [BACKLOG_ITEMS]. Your task is to: 1) Decompose [BACKLOG_ITEMS] into SAFe user stories and enabler tasks, 2) Assign roles to each task based on expertise, 3) Define dependencies and risks, 4) Generate a sprint plan with daily standup scripts, and 5) Create a definition of done (DoD) checklist. Use the SAFe PI Planning template structure. Respond with a structured report in Markdown format.
```
